events.title: AlterMage Demo Update - v0.13.2
events.summary: Hey everyone!I just released a small update for the demo to make some improvements to sprinting based on feedback I've been hearing from players. With this update sprinting no longer drains stamina, and in addition, sprinting is no longer stopped after jumping. This should make things feel a lot more fluid and help with Energy deprivation issues.Thanks to the players who brought this issue to my attention, as I think these improvements will make for a more enjoyable experience for all players. events.title: AlterMage reveal!
events.summary: Hey everyone!I'm excited to announce AlterMage, my new first-person metroidvania indie game that is coming to Steam and PS5!I've been quietly working on this game for 2 years and finally decided to quit my job to start developing it full time in earnest! I'm planning to launch the demo within the next few months (hopefully), so keep an eye out for that!I'll be posting more details on the game soon across various social media, so check 'em out to see more stuff about the game!Cheers!- JustinWebsi
